items.title: Upload and submit
items.claim: Codex package validation requires logo/composerIcon; portable upload may omit them but public submission needs a primary icon. Skills-only URL import is not a privacy waiver; existing skills-only public listing cannot gain MCP; approval and Publish are separate.

items.title: Submission errors
items.claim: Final submission can fail after upload; skills-only and MCP checks differ. Annotation justification language conflicts with guidelines.

items.title: Plugin guidelines
items.claim: Production utility, accurate ownership/capabilities and privacy remain gates; demos are not accepted. Says annotation justifications no longer required, conflicting with error/review guidance.

items.title: Security and Privacy
items.claim: Least privilege, minimization, consent and injection tests remain engineering responsibilities; packaging checks do not establish host retention or resistance.

items.title: Remote MCP review
items.claim: Annotation justification and MCP endpoint-change guidance remain inconsistent with other primary pages; no portal/support evidence resolves them.
